description: This file handles the checkout process in an e-commerce application. It manages user session verification, processes order placement including sanitization of input data, interacts with the database to insert new orders and clear the cart, and displays the order summary and form for inputting order details.

methods.name: session_start
methods.description: Starts a new session or resumes an existing one.

methods.name: header
methods.description: Sends a raw HTTP header to redirect the user if not logged in, or for other headers.

methods.name: filter_var
methods.description: Sanitizes user input data before database insertion.
